name: web-oversized-welcome-portfolio-footer
title: Portfolio footer with a giant boxed WELCOME in tech-rounded type
whatItIs: A cropped laptop above a white footer: a row of small text links, a short greeting, and an enormous black 'WELCOME' in wide rounded letters, each character in its own cell separated by thin vertical lines and cropped at the edge.
whatItMeans: Bold, calm and confident; the oversized word makes the footer the finale.
techniques: Set a single giant word across the whole width of the footer.
Separate letters with hairline grid cells for a drafting-sheet look.
Crop the letterforms at the bottom and sides for scale.
Keep everything else tiny so the word dominates.

vocabulary.definition: A huge word closing the page.
A layout style resembling technical drawings.
